version.approval_notes:
Build (Node.js 20+, macOS or Linux):
  npm ci
  npm run vendor   # copies the two vendored runtime files into extension/vendor/
  npm run build    # zips extension/ into web-ext-artifacts/local-live-captions-1.4.2.xpi

extension/vendor/ holds exactly two files copied verbatim from the @huggingface/transformers
npm package pinned at 3.8.1 (integrity in package-lock.json): dist/transformers.min.js and
dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.wasm. Unminified sources: github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
tag 3.8.1. Every other file is hand-written source as in the archive. The two DANGEROUS_EVAL
lint warnings are the Function constructor inside that vendored onnxruntime loader; the add-on's
own code uses neither eval nor Function.

Changes since 1.3.0, the last version submitted:

1. New optional permission "downloads" (1.4.0). Declared under optional_permissions and
requested with permissions.request() only when the user ticks Settings > Transcript
(extension/options/options.js); declining leaves the feature off. Used for a single call,
downloads.download() on a blob: URL built in the background page from the tab's caption lines
(background.js, saveTranscript), only when the user clicks Save. Transcripts live in memory,
are cleared on tab close, navigation and when the setting is switched off (clearTranscripts),
and are never sent anywhere. The privacy policy has been updated to say so.

2. Recogniser robustness (1.4.1): worker requests have a watchdog; a restart now fails pending
requests instead of dropping them; WebGPU checks navigator.gpu.requestAdapter() before loading
and falls back to WebAssembly. No permission or network change.

3. Settings (1.4.2): a "Use recommended settings" button and corrected precision labels.

Network access is unchanged from 1.3.0: model files (.onnx weights, tokenizer and config JSON —
data parsed by the bundled runtime, never executed) from huggingface.co, chosen from a fixed list
in the Settings page; a user-configured transcription endpoint, off by default; and, when a
page's own player cannot be captured, a second CORS request to that same media URL, read only
and never played (Settings can turn this off).

Note on 1.3.0: the source archive attached to 1.3.0 was generated from the previous commit
(1.2.1) by mistake, so it lacked the 1.3.0 stream code. This archive matches 1.4.2 exactly, and
the archive script now refuses to run unless the committed manifest matches the version built.

release_notes.en-US:
New, off by default: save captions as a text file. Turn on Settings > Transcript and
"Save transcript" (toolbar popup, or the down-arrow button on the caption panel) writes the tab's
captions to Downloads as a .txt file, one timed line per caption. Nothing is kept unless you turn
it on, and nothing is ever uploaded.

Fixed: captions stopping for good after changing the speech model or another engine setting.
A stalled recogniser now restarts itself, and if WebGPU is unavailable or stalls, captioning
carries on on the CPU.

New "Use recommended settings" button restores the fastest, most dependable speech settings.
Precision labels now reflect measured speed.
release_notes.zh-CN:
新功能（默认关闭）：把字幕保存为文本文件。在「设置 > Transcript」中开启后，点击工具栏弹窗里的
「Save transcript」或字幕面板上的向下箭头按钮，就会把当前标签页的字幕写入「下载」文件夹下的 .txt
文件，每条字幕一行并带时间。不开启就什么都不保留，也从不上传任何内容。

修复：更换语音模型或其他引擎设置后字幕会永久停止的问题。识别引擎卡住时现在会自动重启；
WebGPU 不可用或卡住时，会自动改用 CPU 继续生成字幕。

新增「Use recommended settings」按钮，一键恢复最快、最稳定的语音设置。精度选项的说明已按
实测速度修正。
